text:
Ana (CSM): Starting a quick thread to prep MapleHealth's upcoming QBR. Key asks: token burn breakdown, worst-case embedding spike, and a short enablement session for batching + caching. Can we get a day-by-day last-60d snapshot and two forecast scenarios?
Ravi (FinOps): +1. Need: baseline monthly spend, committed credits delta, and an emergency throttle recommendation. Quick mental math: baseline gen tokens ~60M/mo, embeds ~20M/mo. If embed cost = 2x gen, spike to 2.5x for a month is non-trivial.
Jo (Data): I can deliver the data. Will pull last 90d, daily bins, split by model and feature. SQL draft: ```SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, feature, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM usage WHERE account='maplehealth' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY day, feature ORDER BY day;``` Will attach CSVs to the shared QBR folder. ETA 3h.
Priya (AM): FYI customer plans a pilot of similarity search next week which will lean heavily on embeddings. They asked for a "cost-safe" rollout plan.
Ana (CSM): Good to know. For the QBR deck: slide 1 = current burn + model mix, slide 2 = 2 scenarios (one-off 2.5x embed month, steady 8% q/q growth), slide 3 = alert/runbook + enablement plan.
Ravi (FinOps): Propose alerting policy: warn at 30% above baseline projected spend, critical at 60% above baseline OR when remaining credits < 15%. For rollout, recommend a soft-cap on embedding throughput: 1.5M/day by default, escalation required for temporary increases. Thoughts?
Jo (Data): Pulled raw last30d: gen=58,400,000 tokens, embed=19,600,000 tokens. Attached csv: https://redwood.internal/qbr/maple_maple_tokens.csv
qbr-bot: CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/maple_maple_tokens.csv (automated forecast appended: baseline +12%).
Ana (CSM): @Jo please run the two forecast variants and include $ estimates assuming model mix: 65% gen @ $0.0006/token, 35% embed @ $0.0012/token.
Jo (Data): Will output 3 columns: day, tokens, $cost. Also will calculate a 30/60-day runway given current credit balance.
Priya (AM): I'll coordinate a 45-min enablement session covering: batching parameters, KV/prefix caching, and cheap embedding alternatives (lower-dim or sparse indexing). Can we prepare a one-pager with example prompt templates and batching knobs?
Ravi (FinOps): I'll draft the one-pager: quick wins = increase batch size, set prefix cache for common prompts, lower embed dimensionality for search (if acceptable), and sample autoscaling policy. Will post a draft by COB.
Ana (CSM): Add an action item: include instructions to mute console alerts during the enablement demo (we don't want noisy paging). Also include how to temporarily allow an approved spike (manual override + tagging).
Jo (Data): Forecasts done. Scenario A (2.5x embed one-month spike) -> month cost +47% vs baseline. Scenario B (8% q/q growth steady) -> month1 +8%, month2 +17%, month3 +26%. Uploading scenario CSVs to folder now.
qbr-bot: Files uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/maple_forecast_scenarioA.csv, https://redwood.internal/qbr/maple_forecast_scenarioB.csv. Auto-generated charts: https://redwood.internal/qbr/maple_charts.png
Priya (AM): Tentatively booked enablement Thurs 11am PT. Will confirm with MapleHealth and send calendar invite.
Ravi (FinOps): Monitoring config created: `alerts/maplehealth/budget` in staging. Webhook set to #cs-costs-test. Testing with `--simulate` now.
Ana (CSM): Please add `snooze_window` for the enablement slot and a playbook: who to call (CSM, AM, Eng on-call) when critical triggers fire.
Ravi (FinOps): Done. Playbook added to slide notes and Console. Also added rollback knob: auto-downscale embeddings to a QoS tier (best-effort) if critical threshold reached.
Jo (Data): One more note: embedding tokens per call jumped 30% on two days last week due to debug payloads — flagged and filtered in the CSV. Recommend they sanitize dev/test traffic.
Priya (AM): Noted. I'll ask the customer to gate non-prod traffic and provide the exact timestamp windows.
Ana (CSM): OK team: Action list -> Jo: attach final CSVs + charts, Ravi: one-pager + monitoring config + playbook, Priya: confirm session and collect dev/test traffic windows, Ana: assemble deck and send for review by tomorrow 9:30am PT.
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR checklist updated: "MapleHealth cost scenarios + enablement" assigned to Ana, due in 14 hours. :bell:
